name: CA-08
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent John Garamendi running with large cash advantage
Republican opponent minimally funded ($235 on hand)
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~96%
model.rationale: Garamendi holds a D+19 district with a $1.2 million war chest against an opponent who has raised about $20,000, and markets price his reelection near certain. With no polls or expert ratings to contradict the fundamentals, the race stays firmly in Safe D territory.
model.watch: Any late surge in Republican outside spending or an unexpected polling miss would be the only realistic path to narrowing this margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
John Garamendi, a Democratic incumbent, is seeking reelection in a Northern California district that leans Democratic by 19 points. He has raised about $489,000 and holds roughly $1.2 million on hand, while Republican Rudy Recile has raised about $20,000 and reported only $235 in cash. No outside groups are active in the race, and no general-election polls or expert ratings are available.

Prediction markets put Garamendi's chances around 96 percent, consistent with the district's fundamentals and the lopsided financial picture. The main uncertainty is the absence of polling, which widens the error band slightly, but every available signal points to a comfortable Democratic win.
